text:
Jordan (CEO): Quick week-ahead flash brief — high level items and a few metrics. TL;DR: Private pilot launch, focus on latency SLAs, and a short policy tweak.

Jordan (CEO): Priorities: 1) Ship Redwood Private pilot to Customer X (security review green). 2) Improve P95 latency for streaming endpoints to <250ms in US-W. 3) Finalize the Dedicated capacity pricing proposal for sales.

Sam (VP Ops): Great. Ops will dedicate a burst pool for the pilot. Expect a small config freeze Wed-Fri while we validate autoscaling behavior.

Priya (Head of Product): PM note: We'll cut a short feature flag for structured-output on the pilot so we can A/B toggle. Need eng readiness by EOD Thu.

Alex (Eng Manager): Eng runtime: backlog item to land a micro-optimization in KV cache handling today — should shave ~6-8% latency for longer contexts. Will post perf numbers once CI finishes.

Leah (SRE): Incident recap (from last Thu): SSO outage root cause = auth-proxy config drift after a hotfix. Mitigation applied: rollback + tighter deploy guard. Postmortem draft will be posted in #postmortems by EOD tomorrow.

Olivia (Legal): Minor policy update: default workspace logs retention is changing from 30 -> 90 days for Hosted tier to support audit requests. Customers can opt for shorter retention; we'll publish the updated policy doc and an email template for CSMs.

Jordan (CEO): Metrics snapshot: weekly active API tenants +4%, onboarding conversion (free->paid) 7.1% (up 0.5ppt), infra cost per 1M tokens down ~12% vs last month. Uptime: 99.98% last 7d.

Jordan (CEO): Launch checklist highlights: security review ✅, compliance signoff pending (Olivia), rollout plan + canary thresholds in the console, and a fallback model variant pinned. Please double-check rollback runbook.

Sam (VP Ops): Runbook link: <https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/private-pilot> and quick status command: `deploy-bot status --env=pilot --team=private`

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for pilot cluster. Canary will start in 6 minutes. Monitor `#release-war-room`.

Priya (Head of Product): Small ask: marketing will send a customer-facing note after we validate pilot stability for 48h. Avoid public comms until then.

Alex (Eng Manager): Noted. Tagging runtime and infra leads to watch KPIs: p50, p95, cold-starts, and memory growth.

Leah (SRE): Also adding a temporary alert: `kv-cache-error-rate > 0.5%` over 5m -> page oncall.

Jordan (CEO): Thanks team — short week, high impact. Quick wins matter. Shoutout to Eng Runtime & SRE for the fast auth rollback last week :raised_hands:. I'll follow up with the full deck tomorrow morning.
